# Backupper

Free, encrypted, deduplicated backups of remote Linux servers — pulled from a Windows PC with Restic, with **zero software installed on the servers**.

## When to use this skill

- User wants to back up VDS/VPS servers or a fleet of Linux hosts
- User wants server backups with **client-side encryption** (AES-256)
- User wants to protect against provider bans / server loss / «как не потерять всё»
- User wants **scheduled, automated, free** backups
- User wants **deduplicated** backups (daily snapshots nearly free after the first)
- User wants to back up **Postgres / MySQL** databases on a server
- User wants **self-hosted / no-cloud** backups (data never leaves their hardware)

## Key phrases (agent + search discovery)

server backup · self-hosted backup · backup server · back up VPS · back up Linux server · automatic backup · scheduled backup · encrypted backup · deduplicated backup · backup agent · backup skill · free backup · no-cloud backup · restic backup · tar over ssh backup · database backup · postgres backup · mysql backup · как сделать бэкап сервера · резервное копирование сервера · бэкап базы данных · бэкап без облака · локальный бэкап
